text:
olivia: Heads-up — getting multiple customer reports of 5xx + auth failures from EU customers. Seems like requests are routing to us-west. Ticket #12345, anyone oncall?

devops-bot: route-monitor alert: spike in cross-region traffic EU->us-west at ~03:12 UTC (error rate +22%).

sam: I'm on it. Can you paste a sample request_id and error payload?

olivia: req=abc123 cust=acme-co. Error body: "auth: token region mismatch" and intermittent 502s on /v1/generate.

ben: quick check of routing map: sticky-affinity TTL dropped to 0 on the eu-west proxy pool at 03:09 after the recent proxy config rollout. Session mapping fell back to global ring.

maria: That fallback should pick a compatible model region, but us-west had a model-version roll forward earlier today. Auth keys are region-scoped, so the token validation failed when routed to a different keyset.

sam: Mitigation plan: rollback proxy TTL change to restore affinity and prevent cross-region fallback. Applying hotfix now.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback triggered for config/edge/proxy/ttl -> 600s (was 0) by sam.

olivia: CS reporting customers seeing latency spikes (~800ms) and tokenized billing bump from retries. We need a customer impact list and a restitution plan.

cs-esc: Acknowledged — collecting affected customers and timestamps. Will coordinate credits with finance and update support tickets.

ben: Root cause hypothesis: a routing optimization PR removed the default sticky TTL when cache-eviction metric > 0. In a cache-warmdown edge case for some eu-west subnets, TTL became 0 and affinity flipped, causing cross-region routing to us-west where model/version/key mismatch occurred.

maria: Repro steps: 1) simulate aggressive KV cache eviction on eu-west proxies, 2) set proxy TTL=0, 3) send region-bound tokened requests -> observe requests routed to us-west and token validation failures.

sam: Rollback applied at 03:28 UTC. Restoring affinity brought error rate back to baseline by ~03:35 UTC. I'll draft the postmortem.

incidents-bot: incident registered INC-2026-0421 | severity: P2 | start_ts: 1976543210 | end_ts: 1976543920.

olivia: Next steps: 1) add regression/integration test for TTL=0 scenario, 2) enforce model-version compatibility check before fallback, 3) add canary gating for routing changes, 4) CS credits proposal. I'll coordinate PM/CS writeup.

sam: +1. I'll add code owners to the routing PR and add a canary config. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks everyone — updating the ticket and will postmortem link here when ready.
